playoffs.bracket_basis: Seeded on leak-free projected points (points to date plus the projected rest-of-season rate). Series and Cup odds return with the game model.
playoffs.odds_unavailable_reason: Playoff and Cup odds return once the season simulator is validated on the leak-free game model; the bracket is seeded on projected points.
playoffs.projection_basis: Projected final points: points to date plus the remaining games at a blend of the leak-free preseason team model and results to date, weighting results by games / (games + 40).

warnings: coherence audit requires at least 24 shared teams; found 0

recent_basis: Recent mover lists use custom rating changes versus the 2026-10-30 snapshot, which is the day before the weighted-median 10th most recent team game. Skater movers use overall talent score, team movers use total team score, goalie movers use goalie score, and usage lists compare the most recent 10 games to the previous 10.
